title: HyperLogLog & Distinct Counting
interviewAnswer: HyperLogLog estimates the number of distinct elements from hashed leading-zero statistics, giving low relative error with very small memory and easy merging.
why: Unique-user and cardinality queries are common analytics operations that become expensive with exact sets.
intuition: A long leading-zero run is unlikely unless many distinct hashes were observed; many registers stabilize the estimate.
deepDive: Distributed HLL sketches can merge register-wise without exchanging raw identifiers.
production: Use exact counting for small sets and sketches when scale justifies approximation.
workedExample: Services can estimate global daily active users by merging local sketches.
